a: [EX2-045 Calumon] is a card with no level, so it isn't considered to have the same level even though it's the same card, and you can't use this card's effect to trash it.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to trash [EX2-045 Calumon] from my hand when an opponent's Lv.- [EX2-045 Calumon] is deleted?

Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, by trashing 1 card of the same level in your hand, ＜Draw 2＞. (Draw 2 cards from your deck.)
